mapper.sql: AND EXISTS ( SELECT B1.DEPTID FROM HR_DEPARTMENT B1 WHERE B1.DEPTNO = HE.DEPTNO START WITH B1.DEPTNO IN ( SELECT HRD.DEPTID FROM HR_DEPARTMENT HRD WHERE HRD.MANAGER_EMP_ID = #{adminID, jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) CONNECT BY PRIOR B1.DEPTNO = B1.PARENT_DEPT_NO UNION SELECT SI.DEPTNO FROM AR_SUPERVISOR_INFO SI WHERE SI.DEPTNO = HE.DEPTNO AND SI.PERSON_ID = #{adminID, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )

WITH OUT_DAYS AS ( SELECT DISTINCT AR.PERSON_ID, AR.AR_DATE_STR FROM AR_MAC_RECORDS_HTSV AR WHERE AR.ACTIVITY = 1 AND AR.DOOR_TYPE = 'OUT' AND AR.AR_DATE_STR >= TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{fromDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'YYYY/MM/DD') AND AR.AR_DATE_STR <= TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{toDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'YYYY/MM/DD') ), OUT_GROUPS AS ( SELECT OD.PERSON_ID, TO_DATE(REPLACE(OD.AR_DATE_STR, '/', '-'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS AR_DATE, TO_DATE(REPLACE(OD.AR_DATE_STR, '/', '-'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OD.PERSON_ID ORDER BY OD.AR_DATE_STR) AS GRP_KEY FROM OUT_DAYS OD ), STREAKS AS ( SELECT OG.PERSON_ID, MIN(OG.AR_DATE) AS STREAK_FROM, MAX(OG.AR_DATE) AS STREAK_TO, COUNT(*) AS DAY_COUNT FROM OUT_GROUPS OG GROUP BY OG.PERSON_ID, OG.GRP_KEY HAVING COUNT(*) >= #{minDays, jdbcType=NUMERIC} ), STREAK_DETAIL AS ( SELECT S.PERSON_ID, S.STREAK_FROM, S.STREAK_TO, S.DAY_COUNT, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT D.AR_DATE_STR) FROM AR_DETAIL_HTSV D WHERE D.PERSON_ID = S.PERSON_ID AND D.AR_DATE_STR >= TO_CHAR(S.STREAK_FROM, 'YYYY/MM/DD') AND D.AR_DATE_STR <= TO_CHAR(S.STREAK_TO, 'YYYY/MM/DD')) AS DETAIL_DAY_COUNT FROM STREAKS S )

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT INNER_Q.*, ROWNUM AS RN FROM ( SELECT SD.PERSON_ID, HE.EMPID, HE.LOCAL_NAME, HE.DEPTNO, GET_DEPT_NAME(HE.DEPTNO, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS DEPT_NAME, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(HE.POST_GRADE_NO, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS POST_GRADE_NAME, TO_CHAR(SD.STREAK_FROM, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS STREAK_FROM, TO_CHAR(SD.STREAK_TO, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS STREAK_TO, SD.DAY_COUNT, SD.DETAIL_DAY_COUNT
ORDER BY SD.DAY_COUNT DESC, SD.STREAK_TO DESC, HE.DEPTNO, HE.EMPID ) INNER_Q WHERE ROWNUM <= #{start, jdbcType=NUMERIC} + #{length, jdbcType=NUMERIC} ) WHERE RN > #{start, jdbcType=NUMERIC}

SELECT TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(REPLACE(AR.AR_DATE_STR, '/', '-'), 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS AR_DATE, (SELECT GET_GLOBAL_NAME(MAX(SH.SHIFT_NO), #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) FROM AR_SCHEDULE_HTSV SH WHERE SH.PERSON_ID = AR.PERSON_ID AND SH.AR_DATE_STR = AR.AR_DATE_STR) AS SHIFT_NAME, TO_CHAR(MIN(CASE WHEN AR.DOOR_TYPE = 'IN' THEN AR.R_TIME END), 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI') AS IN_TIME, TO_CHAR(MAX(CASE WHEN AR.DOOR_TYPE = 'OUT' THEN AR.R_TIME END), 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI') AS OUT_TIME, COUNT(*) AS SWIPE_COUNT, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM AR_DETAIL_HTSV D WHERE D.PERSON_ID = AR.PERSON_ID AND D.AR_DATE_STR = AR.AR_DATE_STR) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS HAS_DETAIL FROM AR_MAC_RECORDS_HTSV AR INNER JOIN HR_EMPLOYEE HE ON HE.PERSON_ID = AR.PERSON_ID WHERE AR.ACTIVITY = 1 AND AR.PERSON_ID = #{personId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND AR.AR_DATE_STR >= TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{streakFrom, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), 'YYYY/MM/DD') AND AR.AR_DATE_STR <= TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{streakTo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), 'YYYY/MM/DD') AND HE.CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
GROUP BY AR.PERSON_ID, AR.AR_DATE_STR ORDER BY AR.AR_DATE_STR
